source.behavior: Open the current tenant's site SMTP diagnostics surface, resolve enabled recipient state for the selected site, and expose the saved SMTP profile only as non-secret diagnostic context.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The existing real Laravel diagnostics workspace is explicitly operation-bound. The GET route authenticates the caller, establishes tenant context, authorizes tenant.view + sites.view + settings.manage, resolves the site through tenant-scoped models, rereads persisted SMTP/recipient state, and renders the real diagnostics view without exposing secret material.

authorization.guest_semantics: redirect to canonical login before tenant-owned diagnostics are rendered
authorization.direct_id_semantics: the numeric site ID is resolved under the authenticated TenantContext; a foreign tenant site ID returns 404

tenant_isolation.server_derived_ownership: TenantContext comes from the active authenticated membership and the controller verifies the route tenant slug before tenant-scoped Site, recipient, or SMTP profile reads are returned.
tenant_isolation.idor_proof: Focused acceptance creates separate Alpha and Beta sites and proves Alpha cannot render Beta by substituting either the foreign site ID or the foreign tenant slug.

read_and_failure_semantics.authoritative_reread: Each GET resolves the current Site plus persisted recipient and SMTP profile state; the empty state is rendered when no saved site profile or enabled recipient exists.
read_and_failure_semantics.truthful_success: 200 is asserted only after the guarded controller resolves the active tenant site and renders real persisted data.
read_and_failure_semantics.empty_state: the real view renders deterministic no-profile and no-enabled-recipient messages
read_and_failure_semantics.retry: safe; GET is read-only and repeatable
read_and_failure_semantics.cancellation: not applicable to synchronous route rendering

secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.smtp_secret_non_exposure: The route exposes only non-secret SMTP view fields and never renders saved password ciphertext, SMTP passwords, provider secrets, or the plaintext secret used by focused acceptance.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.provider_calls: Opening this route does not send mail, probe SMTP, or invoke an external email provider.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.wordpress_connector: No WordPress or Connector call is performed.
secret_provider_wordpress_boundaries.queue_cache_scheduler: No queue, cache, scheduler, or background job side effect is introduced.

canonical_boundaries.diagnose_operation: AIMW-BILL-EE42461195 remains bound only to POST /email-diagnostics/diagnose.
canonical_boundaries.send_test_operation: AIMW-BILL-BC093D6418 remains bound only to POST /email-diagnostics/send-test.
canonical_boundaries.back_visible_control: AIMW-EMAI-8E56589573 remains the separate Back to email settings visible control.
canonical_boundaries.selected_operation: Only the diagnostics Open/render GET route is claimed.

terminality.basis: A real guarded tenant-qualified Laravel diagnostics route is explicitly bound to AIMW-EMAI-E4EEF1914B and proven with authoritative persisted reads, empty-state rendering, permission/tenant failure semantics, read-only behavior, secret non-exposure, and separation from sibling SMTP controls.
